title: Verification — Distinguish supervisor observation failure from absence
body:
Current main `4b556147e42f0e91b85d31584ed2843c58c710ef` (tree `ea0005df842640cb59ee8a46448abe92b3c59b95`) contains a verification-contract defect in `scripts/test-runtime-operability.mjs`: `listSupervisorProcessIds` maps a nonzero/failed `ps` command and the unsupported Windows branch to `[]`, the same value as a successful empty observation. Malformed output can also become empty. The suite compares exact PID arrays, despite its count-oriented assertion wording.

A controlled evaluation of the actual current helper, with no real process command or retained runtime mutation, reproduced successful empty, nonzero, timeout, malformed and Windows-placeholder results as `[]`; two failed observations compare equal. The desired distinction assertion fails on current source.

Bounded correction:
- Reuse one test-owned observation helper with a controlled command seam, called by the existing lifecycle/resume suite.
- Distinguish successful observation, observation failure and platform non-applicability. Required observation failure must prevent PASS; valid empty/nonempty sets retain exact identity preservation.
- Preserve added/missing PID distinctions, all functional assertions, test-owned cleanup, unrelated-process protection, database/side-file checks, natural exit, existing deadlines and maintenance ownership.
- Put baseline observation within cleanup coverage. Final observation failure must neither hide a prior suite failure nor prevent cleanup. Bound diagnostics without public raw process inventories or command lines.
- Regress equal/changed identities, equal-count replacement, both failed observations, timeout/spawn/nonzero/malformed results, Windows non-applicability, cleanup and error preservation through the actual helper.

Historical evidence: PR #1302 and #1304 reported focused ambient supervisor identity-loss failures with successful test-owned cleanup, followed by passing deciding runs. Missing historical `ps` status/stderr evidence must not be invented. Whether those events were observation failures or real supervisor loss remains unproven; this fix does not claim that historical cause is solved.

Delivery: one Draft PR, independent source review, focused contracts plus the affected complete supervisor owner, exact-base/head planner-selected deciding verification and receipt validation. Use installed Companion preview/save for this real task's non-authoritative definition/notes. Preserve failed evidence and no-retry policy. No deadline/coverage reduction, lifecycle redesign, new telemetry/store, retained-data recovery, plugin refresh, managed execution, semantic change, #1261/#1224 work, #1273 resumption, Ready/merge/auto-merge or deployment.
